title: Intumwa z'Imbabazi n'Ububasha
intro: Tekereza ku gicamunsi cy'ituze cyahungabanyijwe n'abashyitsi batazi. Isura yabo ni iy'ibisanzwe, ariko intego yabo ni uko. Bafite ubutumwa bw'Imana buzahindura inzira y'amahanga abiri, bugatera urwenya mu rugo rw'ubutayu n'iterabwoba mu mujyi w'abanyabyaha. Aba bashyitsi b'amayobera ni bande?
clues: Twatumwe ku mugaragu w’Imana w’indahemuka, uzwiho kwakira abashyitsi batagira imipaka.
Twahageze twifashe nk'abantu tutazi, nyamara uwatwakiriye yumvise ikintu kidasanzwe ku bijyanye no kuba turi aho.
Twazanye inkuru yatumye umugore ugeze mu za bukuru aseka cyane, yikubita mu maso atangaye cyane.
Twari dufite inshingano zo kurinda umuryango w’intungane mu gihe imvura yagwaga ku mujyi wuzuyemo ruswa.
Twanze gufata ifunguro twahawe, ibyo byatumye uwatwakiriye arushaho kugira amakenga.
Twahishuye kamere yacu nyayo mbere yo kugenda, tuti: 'Mu by'ukuri, turi intumwa z'Umwami wawe.'

trial.label: Intego yacu
options: Kugira ngo agerageze ukwizera kwa Aburahamu ku mwana we
Kugira ngo atange igitabo cy'Ibyanditswe kuri Aburahamu
Kumenyesha ivuka rya Isaka n'irimbuka ry'ubwoko bwa Loti
Kugira ngo arokore Aburahamu mu muriro
trial.answer: Kumenyesha ivuka rya Isaka n'irimbuka ry'ubwoko bwa Loti

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Sara yabyaye Isaka maze abantu ba Loti bararimbuka
Ubwoko bwa Aburahamu bwarokowe mu mwuzure ukomeye
outcome.answer: Sara yabyaye Isaka maze abantu ba Loti bararimbuka
